item.title: Grace Jennings’ Murder: Accused Killers Are Two Former Lovers
item.description: Vinnie Politan Investigates examines whether the love triangle involving Isaac Apodaca, Kiara McCulley, and Grace Jennings fueled toxic jealousy that allegedly led to Jennings' death. item.title: Murder Victim Who Allegedly Faked Cancer Stole From Grandparents: Uncle

item.title: Woman’s Death ‘Undetermined’ in Alleged Insulin Case: Medical Examiner
item.description: Assistant medical examiner Ben Murie reiterated that Kacee Terry's cause of death was 'undetermined,' meaning he couldn't categorize the cause of death into the other four manners: natural, accident homicide, or suicide. Meggan Sundwall, a registered nurse, is accused of giving Terry a fatal dose of insulin. (3/12/26)
